noise_seed: 2710000 + target_index*1000000 + task*10000 + initial*100 + query; excludes condition
measure_on: every actual policy query on Plain trajectories
aggregation: median across queries per episode, then median and IQR over 30 episodes per target
geometry_control: 30 initial Object states; old ray-grid and production floor placement rendered at identical dynamic states; no actions
scope: Frozen full RefCloth only; no training, target gradients, mask selection or task changes
limitations: 30 paired cases per target, three initial states per task; simulator-only; explicit paired noise differs from the archived main-table randomness; marker contrast is a geometric visibility proxy, not semantic segmentation
